#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent read-only lifetime audit of the completed qualification original."""
import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/workspace/AI-GPU')
PACKET = Path('/workspace/p06-counter-qualified-run-01/evidence/native-qualification')
SOURCE = Path('/workspace/p06-counter-qualified-source-01')
WORK = Path('/workspace/p06-counter-qualified-run-01/work')
REVISION = '17e0284496bab10c7632a48e4f91efb6fb4fec0b'
DEST = ROOT / 'docs/project/evidence/p06-counter-qualification/validation/w07_a02-lifetime-review.json'
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'ci/project'))
import baseline_packet_io as packet_io
import p06_counter_qualification_contract as qualification
import p06_managed_preflight_contract as preflight
import p06_native_lifetime_records as records

def identity(path):
    body = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path':str(path), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(), 'size_bytes':len(body)}

def json_body(body, label):
    return packet_io.load_json_bytes(body, label, max_tokens=500000)

def retained(descriptor):
    path = PACKET / descriptor['path']
    assert path.resolve() == path and PACKET in path.parents
    actual = identity(path)
    assert actual['sha256'] == descriptor['sha256'] and actual['size_bytes'] == descriptor['size_bytes']
    return path.read_bytes()

def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode()).hexdigest()

def helper_sources():
    result=[]
    for module in list(sys.modules.values()):
        name=getattr(module,'__file__',None)
        if not name:
            continue
        path=Path(name).resolve()
        if ROOT in path.parents and path.suffix=='.py':
            result.append(identity(path))
    return sorted({row['path']:row for row in result}.values(),key=lambda row:row['path'])

started=time.monotonic()
original_identity=identity(PACKET/'report.json')
report=json_body((PACKET/'report.json').read_bytes(),'finished native report')
assert report['state']=='finished' and report['outcome']=='pass' and report['reason'] is None
assert report['failures']==[] and report['expected_revision']==REVISION
assert report['native_execution']=='run' and report['counter_qualification_passed'] is True
assert all(report[name] is False for name in preflight.FALSE_CLAIMS)

cases=json_body(b'{"fixtures":'+retained(report['fixture_snapshot'])+b'}','selected fixture wrapper')['fixtures']
assert type(cases) is list

source_projection=qualification.verify_source_projection(proof,source_manifest['files'])

assert [row['id'] for row in report['processes']]==[row['id'] for row in plan]
assert report['paths']['source']==str(SOURCE) and report['paths']['work']==str(WORK)
inputs=[original_identity,identity(PACKET/report['retained_counter_qualification']['path']),

prepared=[]

    saved=json_body(retained(row['retained_observation']),'retained observation')

    inputs += [raw_identity,identity(PACKET/row['binding']['path']),identity(PACKET/row['retained_observation']['path'])]
    expected={name:str(WORK/('simx-'+planned['format'])/'sw/runtime'/name)
        for name in ('libvortex.so','libvortex-simx.so','libsimx.so')}
    expected.update({'libramulator.so':str(SOURCE/'third_party/ramulator/libramulator.so'),
        'libramulator-vortex.so':str(SOURCE/'third_party/ramulator_ext/libramulator-vortex.so')})
    prepared.append((row,planned,case,raw.decode('utf-8'),expected))

# Read the trusted warm contract now; the verifier repeats its actual normal read.

git_matches=[]

    body=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',REVISION+':'+relative],cwd=ROOT)
    assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()==item['sha256']

producer_reads=[]
prohibited_roots=(str(SOURCE),str(WORK),'/workspace/p06-counter-qualified-run-01/tools')
def audit(event,args):
    if event.startswith('socket.') or event in ('subprocess.Popen','os.system','os.posix_spawn','os.fork','os.forkpty'):
        events.append(event)
        raise AssertionError('prohibited execution/network event: '+event)
    if event=='open' and args and isinstance(args[0],(str,bytes)):
        path=args[0].decode() if isinstance(args[0],bytes) else args[0]
        if any(path==prefix or path.startswith(prefix+'/') for prefix in prohibited_roots):
            producer_reads.append(path)
            raise AssertionError('verifier opened producer path')
sys.addaudithook(audit)

processes=[]

for row,planned,case,text,expected_libraries in prepared:
    verified=records.verify_output(text,contract=contract,case=case,fmt=planned['format'],
        policy=planned['policy'],binding_id=row['execution_binding_sha256'],

    assert verified==row['observation']

    assert life['seeded'] is False and life['simulation_workers']==1 and life['checked_counter_bits']==64
    assert [value['ordinal'] for value in life['runs']]==list(range(1,34))
    base=life['constructed_state']['reset_generation']

    assert [value['before']['reset_generation'] for value in life['runs']]==list(range(1,34))

    models=[life['constructed_state'],life['destruction']['before']]

    models += [value[side] for value in life['snapshots'] for side in ('before','after')]
    assert len(models)==76
    assert all(value['pending_reads']==0 and value['idle'] is True and value['any_running'] is False
        and value['live'] is True and value['generation']==1 and value['exitcode']==0 for value in models)
    read_pairs=life['reads']+life['cache_flush_reads']
    assert len(life['reads'])==264 and len(life['cache_flush_reads'])==33
    assert sorted(value['sequence'] for value in read_pairs)==list(range(1,298))

    previous=life['constructed_state']

        assert cp['tail_register_pair_raw']==cp['runtime_tail']
        assert cp['head_writeback_status']=='not-published' and cp['head_writeback_raw']==0
    assert terminal['cp_after']['retired']-terminal['cp_before']['retired']==66
    assert life['destruction']['completed'] is True and life['destruction']['idle_after'] is True
    assert life['destruction']['ticks_after']==0 and life['destruction']['reset_after']==34
    assert all(observation[name]==0 for name in ('run_errors','dcr_read_errors','dcr_write_errors',
        'overflow_errors','underflow_errors','negative_operand_errors','unexpected_errors','violations'))
    assert observation['constructed']==observation['destroyed']==observation['constructor_entries']==observation['destructor_entries']==1
    assert observation['live'] is False
    assert observation['run_entries']==observation['run_completed']==33
    assert observation['read_count']==264 and observation['dcr_read_entries']==observation['dcr_read_completed']==297
    assert observation['cache_flush_count']==33
    assert [value['role'] for value in warm['operations']]==['prime']+['sample']*32
    assert warm['phase']=='warmup' and warm['pair_index']==0
    snapshot_names=['after_open','after_prime','after_batch','before_release']

    assert warm['summary']['counts']['live_buffers']==warm['summary']['counts']['live_requested_bytes']==0
    assert warm['summary']['counts']['device_open_calls']==warm['summary']['counts']['device_release_calls']==1
    assert warm['summary']['device_release']['status']==0
    totals.update(processes=1,runs=len(life['runs']),snapshots=len(life['snapshots']),

        'model_generation':1,'final_live':observation['live'],'phase':warm['phase'],'pair_index':warm['pair_index']})
